## About
Austin's Transmission and Clutch Specialists is a family owned and operated transmission and general automotive shop. We've always been family run, and we work hard to diagnose your problem and fix your car in the most cost and time effective way we can.
Our ASE certified technicians are happy to answer your questions and put your mind at ease. Mark Barnett has been our head transmission builder and diagnostician since we first opened, Javier Lopez builds transmissions and handles general repairs, James Burns is a transmission builder and complete car specialist, and Matt Nelson runs the shop as General Manager.
Whether your car is an automatic or a manual, our goal is simple: get you back behind the wheel and on the road as quickly as possible.

## Services
- Transmission service: Transmission rebuilds, maintenance and repair.
- Clutch and hydraulic service: Comprehensive clutch and hydraulic service for domestic and foreign cars and trucks.
- Brake repair: Brake repair is a service you can't skimp on, and we handle it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on both automatics and manuals?
A: Yes. Whether your car is an automatic or a manual, our trained technicians can handle it.

Q: Can I get an estimate without coming in?
A: Yes. Fill out the quick estimate form on our site and we'll send you an estimate by email.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. We work with two financing companies to help you get your car back on the road. Contact us to find out more.

Q: Do you honor external warranty insurances?
A: Yes, we honor external warranty insurances for your convenience.
